beef cattle feed efficiency open data

searchCoverage.summary: No new public record in this search met the complete mature beef-cow pasture total-DMI gate. One new Brazilian pasture-biomass cohort was downloaded and processed for a separate forage module.

technicalAccess.downloadEndpoint: HTTP 401 (bearer token required); direct file stream returned HTTP 403

candidates.population: Six Jersey heifers and three Angus×Brahman heifers in two Brazilian grazing experiments.
candidates.target: Observed short-term dry-matter intake rate (STIR), not daily total DMI.
candidates.measurementMethod: Double weighing before and after grazing sessions, corrected for dry matter; source article describes intake rate per session.
candidates.units: g DM/min for intake rate; forage/sward covariates also reported.
candidates.grainAndGroups: Individual/session according to source article; animal and experiment keys require confirmation in CSV, which was not obtained.
candidates.decisionReason: The source would support a distinct intake-rate cohort, but the source bytes are unavailable through the unauthenticated download route in this environment; the target is not total daily DMI in mature beef cows.
candidates.bestSeparateUse: Short-term intake-rate cohort if data bytes become directly downloadable without restricted authentication.

technicalAccess.downloadEndpoint: HTTP 401 (bearer token required); direct file stream returned HTTP 403

candidates.population: Finishing steers on high-concentrate ad-libitum feedlot diets; approximately 18 animals, 17 analyzed.
candidates.target: Individual daily feed intake plus feeding behavior and rumen pH; feedlot cohort only.
candidates.measurementMethod: Automated feed-bin records and rumen bolus; details in source README/article.
candidates.units: DMI reported as kg/24 h; repeated animal-day records with missing values represented as NA.
candidates.grainAndGroups: Animal ID and date; one finishing trial, repeated days per animal.
candidates.decisionReason: Would be a separate feedlot-DMI candidate, but bytes are unavailable through the unauthenticated download route in this environment and population is not the #109 pasture target.
candidates.bestSeparateUse: Feedlot behavior/intake exploration if the file is obtainable through an unprotected public download route.

technicalAccess.downloadEndpoint: HTTP 401 (bearer token required); direct file stream returned HTTP 403

candidates.population: Thirteen-month-old feedlot steers on high-concentrate diets; 24 enrolled, 17 in final analyses.
candidates.target: Daily intake from primary/treatment bins and feeding behavior/preference; not pasture forage intake.
candidates.measurementMethod: Feeder intake and video-coded behavior during aversive-barrier treatment; intake sources and time windows differ by file.
candidates.units: Files include kg/24 h for primary-bin intake, g/24 h for treatment intake, and 24/48-hour behavioral summaries.
candidates.grainAndGroups: Animal ID by 24-hour or 48-hour interval; 17 animals in analysis and some rows removed for technical failure.
candidates.period: Feedlot treatment phases across repeated 24/48-hour periods.
candidates.decisionReason: The useful separate feedlot behavior/preference target is not the #109 target; source bytes are not obtainable without the bearer-token API endpoint during this audit.
candidates.bestSeparateUse: Feedlot feeding motivation/behavior exploration if publicly retrievable without restricted authentication.

technicalAccess.downloadEndpoint: HTTP 401 (bearer token required); direct file stream returned HTTP 403

candidates.population: Twelve dairy heifers offered paired mixed-grass-legume silages.
candidates.target: Feed-specific intake after 30 minutes and 3 hours, for palatability/preference; not total daily DMI.
candidates.measurementMethod: Feed offered and refused during paired preference trials.
candidates.units: kg feed DM after 30 minutes and 3 hours.
candidates.grainAndGroups: 144 rows at heifer × feed × day grain; cow ID, date, feed type and position are described.
candidates.decisionReason: Palatability data are not daily total DMI or beef pasture data, and file bytes were not retrievable through the unauthenticated endpoint during audit.
candidates.bestSeparateUse: Dairy feed-preference analysis if direct public file download becomes available.

candidates.population: Yearling steers at CPER shortgrass rangeland, Colorado, 2019–2020.
candidates.target: Measured period ADG and grazing behavior; satellite-derived standing biomass. No DMI.
candidates.measurementMethod: Period weights and animal-borne GPS/accelerometer behavior; biomass from remote sensing.
candidates.units: ADG kg/head/day; behavior daily/5-minute GPS and 4-second accelerometry; biomass kg DM/ha estimate.
candidates.grainAndGroups: Animal, RFID/eartag, pasture, date, year, deployment and study period.
candidates.decisionReason: Existing public data and checksums are in the repository; outcomes do not include individual DMI and the population is not mature cows.
candidates.bestSeparateUse: Behavior and observational ADG component diagnostics; no causal claim or full-engine validation.

candidates.population: Mostly yearling heifers and steers in long-term North Dakota grazing trials.
candidates.target: Animal weights and ADG, grazing duration, stocking treatment and economics; no individual DMI. AUM is a management assumption.
candidates.measurementMethod: Initial/final liveweights and grazing records across pasture management treatments.
candidates.units: 4,705 animal-season rows; weight/ADG source units converted explicitly in existing audits.
candidates.grainAndGroups: Animal TAG, year, pasture/treatment and trial.
candidates.decisionReason: Longitudinal public performance data are present, but this is not DMI and one site cannot provide geographic independent validation by itself.
candidates.bestSeparateUse: Grouped ADG/performance and management association analysis, not DMI or mature-cow validation.

candidates.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 reported on the competition dataset page; competition access rules also apply.

technicalAccess.downloadRequires: Kaggle account, authentication/token, and acceptance of competition rules

candidates.population: Australian temperate pasture quadrats; 19 sites across four states, 2014–2017.
candidates.target: Laboratory-measured pasture biomass fractions and total dry biomass; no animals or DMI.
candidates.measurementMethod: Quadrat harvest and laboratory dry-matter measurement, paired with images/metadata.
candidates.units: Grams per quadrat/image; 357 training images × five targets in long format according to the official competition record.
candidates.grainAndGroups: Image/quadrat, site, sampling date, species mixture and state; repeated images/measurements must be grouped spatially/temporally.
candidates.decisionReason: Biomass target is relevant to another module, but download requires an authenticated Kaggle account and acceptance of competition rules, which the mission excludes.
candidates.bestSeparateUse: No download or training in this mission; use only if a public direct source without the restricted access gate is identified.

candidates.license: Record API says CC BY 4.0; embedded README says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Terms conflict.
candidates.population: Irish pasture quadrats and 23 paddocks; herbage images collected 2020 and drone images 2021.
candidates.target: Herbage dry mass, composition percentages and height; no animal DMI.
candidates.measurementMethod: Some labels from harvested biomass oven-dried at 16 h; drone paddock labels mix visual expert estimates and strip-cut/dry sampling.
candidates.units: kg DM/ha, component percentages, and post-cutting height in cm.
candidates.grainAndGroups: Image, shared quadrat, plot or paddock; camera/phone pairs share labels and must be grouped by location to avoid leakage.
candidates.period: Camera/phone campaign in 2020; drone extension in late autumn 2021.
candidates.decisionReason: Useful biomass labels exist, but source metadata conflicts with the README license; no commercial training without unambiguous terms. Large image archives were not downloaded.
candidates.bestSeparateUse: Noncommercial-only biomass research after source license scope is resolved from existing public terms; do not use for commercial training in current state.

technicalAccess.downloadMethod: Mendeley public API file URLs, no authentication

candidates.population: Forage samples from two cattle farms in western São Paulo State; pasture vegetation, not animal records.
candidates.target: Dry matter yield from harvested pasture biomass; also source tables for height, fresh biomass and soil properties.
candidates.measurementMethod: 0.25 m² samples harvested; dry weight recorded after oven drying 65 °C for 72 hours; source yield validated against dry g × 40 kg/ha.
candidates.units: 0.25 m² sample dry weight in g; source yield in tonnes/ha; processed target in kg DM/ha.
candidates.grainAndGroups: Sampling point within farm, field, MODIS pixel and campaign; 342 rows, 162 spatial sample groups, 108 observed in multiple campaigns.
candidates.period: June 2018, November 2018, March 2019; soil subset from June 2018 and March 2019.
candidates.decisionReason: Open CC BY source tables were downloaded and checksummed; processing confirmed 342 unique sampling rows, no within-campaign duplicates, expected missingness, spatial repeats and unit arithmetic.
candidates.bestSeparateUse: Forage biomass and pasture productivity module; grouped temporal/spatial evaluation only.

candidates.population: Cool-season grass-legume pasture grazed by yearling beef cattle at one northeastern-US research farm; no animal records in this dataset.
candidates.target: Pre-grazing forage mass and paddock-level height; 623 available quadrat records, aggregated to 64 paddock-time means with 17 missing quadrat target slots retained as missing.
candidates.measurementMethod: Forage quadrat clipping/dry matter and pre-grazing sward height, paired at paddock-time level.
candidates.grainAndGroups: Quadrat nested in treatment and replicate paddock; eight repeated paddocks across calendar years and Julian days.
candidates.decisionReason: Open CC0 row-level biomass data were downloaded and checksummed. A single-cohort external evaluation against Brazilian Mendeley data exists, but the sampling estimands and production systems differ and performance was poor; this does not validate the Riose engine.
candidates.bestSeparateUse: Forage biomass module evaluation with paddock-grouped splits; not animal DMI or ADG.

candidates.population: 24 beef cattle across four breeds at two New Mexico ranches; sampled daylight sessions in summer/fall 2022.
candidates.target: Human-reviewed minute-level grazing, resting, rumination, and walking labels from motion index; common temporal subset has 5,582 observations across all 24 animals.
candidates.measurementMethod: Wearable sensor plus human-reviewed behavior labels; animal-grouped nested evaluation prevents same-animal overlap between train and outer test.
candidates.units: One labeled observation per animal-minute within sampled sessions.
candidates.grainAndGroups: animal_id, sampled session, animal-minute; breed is confounded with ranch/site.
candidates.decisionReason: Public CC BY data support behavior classification diagnostics only. Nested OOF macro-F1 averaged equally by animal for resting/rumination was 0.403; recall was 0.308 for resting and 0.727 for rumination. This does not validate DMI, ADG, or full-day behavior budgets.
candidates.bestSeparateUse: Behavior classification module diagnostic, with animal-grouped evaluation and low resting recall clearly reported.

candidates.license: Zenodo metadata declares CC BY 4.0; embedded README declares CC BY-NC. No reuse right is claimed.

technicalAccess.metadataAndFiles: Public source record; source archive and derivatives removed from this repository

candidates.decisionReason: The project removed the source archive and derivatives; no dataset values or reuse right are included in this release.

population.required: biologically mature beef cows on pasture
population.reason: No newly discovered source provides a verified individual cohort matching this population.

outcome.required: individual total DMI including forage plus supplement
outcome.reason: New Dryad candidates are inaccessible at the download endpoint or have incompatible feedlot/dairy or short-term rate targets.

units.required: kg DM/head/day, aligned to intake period
units.reason: No new target-compatible source with observed total daily intake and verified units was downloaded.

measurementMethod.required: documented individual intake measurement or transparent source derivation
measurementMethod.reason: No new target-compatible mature-cow pasture intake protocol with local microdata.

timeAndGrain.required: animal-period records with aligned outcome window
timeAndGrain.reason: Potential candidates are either not retrieved or have distinct grains/targets.

animalAndTrialIdentity.required: animal and study/trial/pasture keys sufficient for grouped holdout
animalAndTrialIdentity.reason: No new source has an obtained target-compatible dataset and verified grouping keys.

licenseAndAccess.required: unambiguously public, direct downloadable rights compatible with intended use
licenseAndAccess.reason: Dryad bytes require bearer-authenticated API in this environment; Kaggle requires token/rules; Irish license scope conflicts. Existing qualifying terms do not overcome population/outcome mismatch.

independentEvaluation.required: multiple independent clusters sufficient for grouped evaluation
independentEvaluation.reason: No compatible mature-cow pasture cohort is available for an independent holdout.

issueActions.15: No calibration or interval evidence is created by these sources; keep uncertainty claims outcome-specific and unavailable where no independent matching cohort exists.
issueActions.96: This discovery registry adds module-specific access, license, population, outcome, measurement, period, grouping, and evaluation decisions. The separate DMI/ADG matrix remains 28 sources because the new Mendeley cohort is forage biomass, not a DMI/ADG outcome.
issueActions.109: NO_GO remains; no source passes mature beef-cow pasture total-DMI gate.
issueActions.110: The original target remains untrained; a separate finishing-steer experiment is documented under docs/evidence/dmi-finishing-steers-experiment-v1.json.

limitations: Searches are broad platform queries, not proof that no qualifying data exists anywhere.
Dryad metadata is readable, but each file download endpoint returned HTTP 401 requiring a bearer token; no Dryad file bytes were used in this acquisition increment.
The source license on Irish Grass Clover is internally inconsistent between record metadata and README; commercial reuse is excluded until source terms are unambiguous.
No contacts, private files, purchased datasets, or restricted data were used.
summary: No public record in this search met the complete mature beef-cow pasture total-DMI gate. Separate open cohorts now support biomass, behavior-classification diagnostics, and descriptive dairy behavior profiles, each with explicit outcome boundaries.
